_note: News from the real trailer, shown on the game's home screen (web and app). Edit, commit and push: players see it next time they open the game, no app update needed. message: up to 140 characters (empty = no banner). until: last day to show it (YYYY-MM-DD), or empty for no end. featured: a menu flavour id the real shop is pushing this week (e.g. strawberry); it becomes the in-game special of the day for players who have it.
